name: mini-etsy
description: A small Etsy-style storefront built as a NestJS + Next.js modular monolith.
author: Jimmie Davis

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev -w @mini-etsy/api" "npm run dev -w @mini-etsy/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mini-etsy/api && npm run build -w @mini-etsy/web
